content.title: Paycom Stock Sinks After Earnings. Wall Street Is Worried About the Job Market.
content.summary: Shares of  Paycom Software  fell sharply Thursday even after the human resources software company met earnings expectations.  Paycom  posted adjusted earnings of $1.94 a share for the third quarter, in line with analysts’ consensus forecast of $1.95, per FactSet.  The stock, however, dropped 12% to $161.21 on Thursday, putting it on pace for its lowest close since Oct. 8, 2024, according to Dow Jones Market Data.
